'''Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited''' ({{zh|t=南南資源實業有限公司}}) ({{hkex|1229}}) is a [[Hong Kong]]-based investment holding company. It is primarily focused on mining [[coal in China]], though it also operates in the renewable energy and information technology sectors. Though incorporated in [[Bermuda]] and now headquartered in the [[Admiralty Centre]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited - Corporate Profile |url=https://www.nannanlisted.com/en/about-us.html |access-date=2024-09-06 |website=www.nannanlisted.com |archive-date=2023-03-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230327231313/http://nannanlisted.com/en/about-us.html |url-status=live }}</ref> it is a former [[88 Queensway group]] company<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last=Levkowitz |first=Lee |url=https://www.uscc.gov/sites/default/files/Research/The_88_Queensway_Group.pdf |title=The 88 Queensway Group: A Case Study in Chinese Investors' Operations in Angola and Beyond |last2=Ross |first2=Marta McLellan |last3=Warner |first3=J.R. |date=10 July 2009 |publisher=[[United States–China Economic and Security Review Commission]] |access-date=7 September 2024 |archive-date=20 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201020011158/https://www.uscc.gov/sites/default/files/Research/The_88_Queensway_Group.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> and was formerly known as '''Artfield Group Limited''' ({{Zh|c=雅域集團有限公司}}),<ref name=":1">{{Cite document |last=Fai |first=Kwan Man |date=19 August 2009 |title=CHANGE OF COMPANY NAME AND CHANGE OF COMPANY WEBSITE |type=Announcement |publisher=China Sonangol Resources Enterprise Limited}}</ref> '''China Sonangol Resources Enterprise Limited''' ({{Zh|c=安中資源實業有限公司}}),<ref name=":2">{{Cite document |last=Xiangfei |first=Wang |date=12 April 2011 |title=CHANGE OF COMPANY NAME, STOCK SHORT NAME AND WEBSITE |type=Announcement |place=Hong Kong |publisher=International Resources Enterprise Limited}}</ref> and '''International Resources Enterprise Limited''' ({{Zh|c=國際資源實業有限公司}}).<ref name=":3">{{Cite document |last=Xiangfei |first=Wang |date=4 October 2011 |title=CHANGE OF COMPANY NAME, STOCK SHORT NAME AND WEBSITE |type=Announcement |place=Hong Kong |publisher=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited}}</ref>

== History ==
Artfield Group Limited was founded in 1984 by Hongkonger entrepreneur [[Ip Yiu Tung]]<ref name=":4" /> and taken public on the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] in 1995. It manufactured, marketed, and traded watches,<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Chua |first=Alvin |title=Ip Yiu Tung |url=https://www.nlb.gov.sg/main/article-detail?cmsuuid=a66377a8-edd2-4a8d-8cd4-4a1e59ceefc5 |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=National Library Board Singapore |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173309/https://www.nlb.gov.sg/main/article-detail?cmsuuid=a66377a8-edd2-4a8d-8cd4-4a1e59ceefc5 |url-status=live }}</ref> clocks,<ref>{{Cite web |date=1995-11-28 |title=Artfield pays out on clocks |url=https://www.scmp.com/article/140620/artfield-pays-out-clocks |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=South China Morning Post |language=en |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173418/https://www.scmp.com/article/140620/artfield-pays-out-clocks |url-status=live }}</ref> office products, lights, and metals in [[North America]], [[Europe]], Hong Kong, and [[China]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=1995-07-20 |title=Artfield purchase |url=https://www.scmp.com/article/125013/artfield-purchase |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=South China Morning Post |language=en |archive-date=2020-12-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201203100651/https://www.scmp.com/article/125013/artfield-purchase |url-status=live }}</ref> Artfield was taken over in early 2008 by Ascent Goal Investments Limited, a subsidiary of [[China Sonangol International Limited]]. By March, Ascent had purchased 74% of Artfield and installed [[Lo Fong Hung]] as chairperson and managing director and her husband [[Wang Xiangfei]]<ref>{{Cite book |last=Burgis |first=Tom |title=The looting machine: warlords, oligarchs, corporations, smugglers, and the theft of Africa's wealth |date=2015 |publisher=PublicAffairs |isbn=978-1-61039-748-3 |location=New York}}</ref> and [[Kwan Man Fai]] to the board.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=Vines |first=Alex |url=https://www.chathamhouse.org/sites/default/files/r0809_africanoil.pdf |title=Thirst for African oil: Asian national oil companies in Nigeria und Angola |last2=Wong |first2=Lillian |last3=Weimer |first3=Markus |last4=Campos |first4=Indira |date=2009 |publisher=Chatham House |isbn=978-1-86203-220-0 |editor-last=Vines |editor-first=Alex |series=A Chatham House report |location=London |access-date=2024-09-07 |editor-last2=Wong |editor-first2=Lillian |editor-last3=Weimer |editor-first3=Markus |editor-last4=Campos |editor-first4=Indira |editor-last5=Royal Institute of International Affairs |editor-last6=Revenue Watch Institute |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173310/https://www.chathamhouse.org/sites/default/files/r0809_africanoil.pdf |archive-date=2024-09-07 |url-status=live}}</ref> Artfield's head office was relocated to the tenth floor of [[Pacific Place (Hong Kong)|Two Pacific Place]], 88 [[Queensway (Hong Kong)|Queensway]], [[Admiralty, Hong Kong|Admiralty]], Hong Kong, the site of Ascent, [[China Sonangol International Holdings Limited|China Sonangol International]], and dozens of other businesses Hung, Xiangfei, and Fai are collectively involved with. Under their leadership, Artfield pivoted away from lights and metals and into natural resources, particularly the petroleum industry.<ref name=":0" />

In August 2008, [[Soviet Union|Soviet]]-born [[Israel]]i diamond magnate [[Lev Avnerovich Leviev|Lev Leviev]] personally and through his companies [[Africa Israel Investments|Africa Israel Financial Assets and Strategies Ltd]] and [[Memorand Management Limited]] purchased a total 10% share of the Artfield Group. One week later, China Sonangol International Holdings Limited, on whose board of directors Hung and Xiangfei sat, purchased nearly one billion US$ worth of [[Manhattan]] real estate from Africa Israel International, including [[23 Wall Street]] and shares in [[229 West 43rd Street]] and [[Metropolitan Life Insurance Company Tower|the Met Life Tower]]. Kwan Man Fai signed the deed to 23 Wall Street while acting as vice-president of [[CS Wall Street LLC]]. Such sales while negotiating for ownership were potentially breaches of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's listing rules.<ref name=":0" />

In August 2009, Artfield Group Limited was renamed China Sonangol Resources Enterprise Limited,<ref name=":0" /> trading under the name China Sonangol on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.<ref name=":1" /> In 2011, the company would change its identity to International Resources Enterprise Limited in April<ref name=":2" /> and then to Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited in October.<ref name=":3" /> From 2014 to 2019, Nan Nan Resources would suffer a 56% decline in stock value over five years. The company had been running at a loss from 2013 to 2017 when it returned to profitability and its stock value jumped 19%.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-12-31 |title=Introducing Nan Nan Resources Enterprise (HKG:1229), The Stock That Slid 56% In The Last Five Years |url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/introducing-nan-nan-resources-enterprise-005423042.html |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=Yahoo Finance |language=en-US}}</ref> Wong Sze Wai was appointed executive director in November 2018,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-11-20 |title=BRIEF-Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Appoints Wong Sze Wai As An Executive Director |url=https://www.yahoo.com/news/brief-nan-nan-resources-enterprise-135852273.html |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=Yahoo News |language=en-US |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173422/https://www.yahoo.com/news/brief-nan-nan-resources-enterprise-135852273.html |url-status=live }}</ref> replacing Lo Fong Hung. Wang Xiangfei resigned in September 2021 and was replaced by Li Chun Fung.<ref>{{Cite web |last=MarketScreener |date=2021-09-17 |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited Announces Change of Executive Director and Authorised Representative and Cessation of Alternate Director - MarketScreener |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/NAN-NAN-RESOURCES-ENTERPR-6170892/news/Nan-Nan-Resources-Enterprise-Limited-Announces-Change-of-Executive-Director-and-Authorised-Represent-36457495/ |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=www.marketscreener.com |language=en |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173425/https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/NAN-NAN-RESOURCES-ENTERPR-6170892/news/Nan-Nan-Resources-Enterprise-Limited-Announces-Change-of-Executive-Director-and-Authorised-Represent-36457495/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2024, Nan Nan Resources struggled to maintain a positive cash flow, suffered a 52% decline in revenue over a twelve-month period, and carried significant debt that made investment analysts wary of its long-term investment value.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-08-01 |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise's (HKG:1229) Earnings Might Be Weaker Than You Think |url=https://simplywall.st/stocks/hk/energy/hkg-1229/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-shares/news/nan-nan-resources-enterprises-hkg1229-earnings-might-be-weak |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=simplywall.st |language=en |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173424/https://simplywall.st/stocks/hk/energy/hkg-1229/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-shares/news/nan-nan-resources-enterprises-hkg1229-earnings-might-be-weak |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-24 |title=Is Nan Nan Resources Enterprise (HKG:1229) A Risky Investment? |url=https://simplywall.st/stocks/hk/energy/hkg-1229/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-shares/news/is-nan-nan-resources-enterprise-hkg1229-a-risky-investment |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=simplywall.st |language=en |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173313/https://simplywall.st/stocks/hk/energy/hkg-1229/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-shares/news/is-nan-nan-resources-enterprise-hkg1229-a-risky-investment |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Subsidiaries ==
Nan Nan Resources fully owns the following companies:

* Harbour Group Holdings Limited, a holding company holding the entirety of issued stock of several IT service outsourcing and consulting companies in Hong Kong, [[Malaysia]], [[Singapore]], and the [[United Kingdom]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited - IT Services |url=https://www.nannanlisted.com/en/media-centre/it-services.html |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=www.nannanlisted.com}}</ref>
* Mulei County Kai Yuan Coal Company Limited ("Kaiyuan Company"), which operates [[Kaiyuan Open Pit Coal Mine]] in [[Changji]], [[Xinjiang]], China.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited - Coal mining |url=https://www.nannanlisted.com/en/media-centre/coal-mining.html |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=www.nannanlisted.com |archive-date=2024-04-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240412174532/https://nannanlisted.com/en/media-centre/coal-mining.html |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2018, the mine briefly shut down operations due to license expiration<ref>{{Cite news |date=2018-04-13 |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Announces Suspension Of Production At Kaiyuan Mine |url=https://jp.reuters.com/article/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-announces-suspension-of-production-at-kaiyuan-mine-idUSFWN1RQ02A/ |access-date=2024-09-07 |work=Reuters |language=en |archive-date=2024-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907173313/https://jp.reuters.com/article/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-announces-suspension-of-production-at-kaiyuan-mine-idUSFWN1RQ02A/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mughal |first=Sarah |date=31 Dec 2018 |title=Nan Nan Resources suspends Kaiyuan coal mine ops pending mining extension permit |url=https://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence/en/news-insights/trending/Cju9nJpoqrMNiXbPjkhNow2 |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=www.spglobal.com |language=en-us |archive-date=2024-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240525040934/https://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence/en/news-insights/trending/cju9njpoqrmnixbpjkhnow2 |url-status=live }}</ref> but renewed operations shortly afterward.<ref>{{Cite news |date=March 16, 2020 |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Says Kaiyuan Company Has Received Renewed Mining Permit |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/nan-nan-resources-enterprise-says-kaiyuan-company-has-received-renewed-mining-pe-idUSFWN2B915K/ |work=[[Reuters]]}}</ref>
* NEFIN Leasing Technologies Limited is a Hong Kong investment company with Malaysia-based NEFIN Technologies Sdn. Bhd. as its own wholly owned subsidiary. NEFIN Technologies is principally involved in the development of solar power systems.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited - Renewable Energy |url=https://www.nannanlisted.com/en/media-centre/renewable-energy.html |access-date=2024-09-07 |website=www.nannanlisted.com |archive-date=2024-04-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240412180121/https://nannanlisted.com/en/media-centre/renewable-energy.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

extract: Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited (Chinese: 南南資源實業有限公司) (SEHK: 1229) is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company. It is primarily focused on mining coal in China, though it also operates in the renewable energy and information technology sectors. Though incorporated in Bermuda and now headquartered in the Admiralty Centre, it is a former 88 Queensway group company and was formerly known as Artfield Group Limited (Chinese: 雅域集團有限公司), China Sonangol Resources Enterprise Limited (Chinese: 安中資源實業有限公司), and International Resources Enterprise Limited (Chinese: 國際資源實業有限公司).
